basic_info.description: Welcome to 431 27th Avenue, a stunning single-family home nestled in the desirable Richmond District. This residence exudes timeless elegance with its exquisite finishes, abundant natural light, and a beautifully landscaped backyard.  The main level is an entertainer's dream, featuring a gourmet chef's kitchen equipped with premium Thermador appliances and a generous peninsula, an inviting living room illuminated by natural light and highlighted by a cozy wood-burning fireplace, and a spacious dining room ideal for large gatherings. You'll also find three comfortable bedrooms, a spa-like bathroom with a dual vanity, and a convenient powder room.  Step down to the lower level, where a large open media room offers direct access to a spacious deck and professionally landscaped garden, complete with an expansive lawn and mature trees. This level also includes another luxurious bathroom, a dedicated home office, and access to a well-appointed garage featuring a gym area, laundry facilities, and a wet bar. 431 27th Avenue offers easy access to charming boutique restaurants and cafes along Clement and California Streets. Nature lovers will appreciate the nearby outdoor escapes, including hiking trails and scenic vistas at Land's End National Park, Baker Beach, and the Presidio.
